en: Vintage-style postcard with a monochrome drawing of an old stone ruin overgrown with vegetation. The structure has arched doorways and partially collapsed walls. At the lower left, the word "Tettye" is written, and at the lower right appears an artist's signature with the date 1987. The reverse side shows a typical divided-back postcard layout with address lines and stamp boxes, but no printing or handwriting.
